installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update -qq
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq jq nginx-light > /dev/null 2>&1
LATEST=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/multitheftauto/mtasa-blue/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | contains("x64.tar.gz")) | .browser_download_url')
cd /tmp
if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then
curl -sSL -o mta.tar.gz "$LATEST"
else
curl -sSL -o mta.tar.gz https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl/multitheftauto_linux_x64.tar.gz
fi
curl -sSL -o base.tar.gz https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl/baseconfig.tar.gz
curl -sSL -o res.zip https://mirror.multitheftauto.com/mtasa/resources/mtasa-resources-latest.zip
mkdir -p /mnt/server
tar -xf mta.tar.gz
cp -r multitheftauto_linux_x64/* /mnt/server/
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16 ]; then
curl -L http://nightly.mtasa.com/files/libmysqlclient.so.16 -o /mnt/server/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/resources
unzip -qo res.zip -d /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/resources
tar -xf base.tar.gz
cp -r baseconfig/* /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/resource-cache/http-client-files
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
echo "===========================================" 
echo "Installation completed - Trident Sky"
echo "Nginx + MySQL + FastDL Ready"
echo "==========================================="

variables.name: Web Port
variables.description: HTTP port for web-based resources and admin panel. Required for resource downloads and server management.

variables.name: FastDL Enabled
variables.description: Enable/Disable FastDL system. When enabled (1), uses Nginx to accelerate resource downloads. Automatically configures httpdownloadurl in mtaserver.conf. Set to 0 to disable, 1 to enable.

variables.name: FastDL Port
variables.description: Nginx port for FastDL service. Resources will be served from http://YOUR_IP:PORT/ when FastDL is enabled. Must be allocated in server ports.
